Congo Ebola Outbreak Surpasses 1,000 Confirmed Cases

The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases, with authorities reporting 254 deaths. A significant challenge for local health officials is contact tracing, which has achieved only a 55% coverage rate. This ongoing outbreak highlights persistent public health challenges in the region.
